answer: Neighbor-Overlap Quorum Gate. An agent joins a work quorum only if its declared peer set overlaps heavily with the quorum's existing members; each accepted member must mirror its live connection graph to the quorum ledger. Isolated clusters fail the threshold, so fake identities must first spend real traffic to garden genuine links into the honest graph. This sets the cost: an attacker must sustain and reveal a dense, continuously audited adjacency fabric per sock puppet, and every velvet edge exposed increases detection.
